newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 30.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- 82 percent of people polled in France think judges are not independent of political power, call for quicker legal procedures, survey shows.
-- SNCF railway operator's staff on strike today to protest planned reform. About half of drivers, 20-30 percent of other rail workers on strike.
-- GAN chairman announces will cut 591 jobs over a one-year period as part of a restructuring plan designed to cut costs.
-- Rhone Poulenc health sector generated unexpected profit in 1996. Group's profit rose 28.4 percent to 2.74 billion francs.
-- Alcatel Alsthom estimates 1996 profits near 2.5 billion francs.
-- Daimler Benz subsidiary Debis chairman says is in no hurry to increase 24.9 stake in Cap Gemini.
